blocks.text: This page tracks the North Vancouver MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for September 2026: $1,290,400 for a typical home, down 3.9% over twelve months.
North Vancouver benchmark prices and trends, September 2026

A typical North Vancouver home carried an MLS® Home Price Index benchmark of $1,290,400 in September 2026. That is little changed at −1.1% on the month, down 1.8% over three months, down 1.6% over six months and down 3.9% over the year. Over three years it is down 5.6%, and over five years little changed at +0.8%.
The weakest one-year move in North Vancouver was for a detached home homes at −6.2%; the strongest was an apartment at −3.2%.
The gap between a detached home ($2,042,000) and an apartment ($769,000) is $1,273,000, and a townhouse ($1,230,400) sits $461,400 above the apartment benchmark.
Against Greater Vancouver, where the all-home benchmark was $1,075,900, North Vancouver is 19.9% above. Over the year Greater Vancouver moved down 5.5% against down 3.9% here.
Of the 20 areas this board reports, North Vancouver ranks 4 by all-home benchmark, with Whistler above it at $1,350,700 and Vancouver West below it at $1,206,600.

Detached homes in North Vancouver: benchmark $2,042,000, down 2.2% in a month, down 2.9% in three months, down 3.5% in six months, down 6.2% in a year, down 8.3% in three years and little changed at +0.2% in five. That is 14.4% above the detached benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,784,700).

Townhouse homes in North Vancouver: benchmark $1,230,400, little changed at −1.4% in a month, down 2.3% in three months, down 2.0% in six months, down 4.9% in a year, down 6.1% in three years and up 5.6% in five. That is 21.0% above the townhouse benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,016,700).

Apartment homes in North Vancouver: benchmark $769,000, little changed at −0.2% in a month, down 2.3% in three months, little changed at −1.4% in six months, down 3.2% in a year, down 4.6% in three years and up 5.5% in five. That is 12.7% above the apartment benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($682,500).

blocks.text: What the North Vancouver figure is
The $1,290,400 North Vancouver figure is a modelled price for a typical home, not a median, and it comes from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® for September 2026.

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a home in North Vancouver?
faq.a: In September 2026, a typical North Vancouver home was $1,290,400, with detached at $2,042,000.

faq.q: Are North Vancouver home prices rising or falling?
faq.a: North Vancouver is down 3.9% over twelve months and down 1.8% over three months.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
